newsitem.title: JAPAN: Singapore finance chief sees rise in currency -- FT.
newsitem.headline: Singapore finance chief sees rise in currency -- FT.

text.p: The Singapore dollar is likely to appreciate this year against the U.S. dollar, Singapore Finance Minister Richard Hu was quoted as telling the Financial Times newspaper in a report in its Wednesday edition.
In an interview given to the newspaper over the weekend, Hu said some strengthening of the Singapore dollar would be desirable to keep inflation down.
He said Singapore, which imports 70 percent of all the goods it consumes, would welcome some degree of appreciation to reduce the cost of the imports.
"One of our objectives is to keep foreign inflation down, so some degree of Singapore dollar appreciation is quite acceptable," Hu was quoted as saying.
But he added that the Monetary Authority of Singapore -- the equivalent of its central bank -- would not seek to guide the currency, but rather would let market forces dictate the rate.
